verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents native Python and JS/TS SDKs for tracing [docs-5] and for querying the API [docs-49]. The SDKs are used across features: client-side prompt caching [docs-23], experiments via `run_experiment` [docs-63, docs-12], and scores via SDK [docs-42]. A team that used Langfuse for about six months independently confirms building against the SDKs [comm-7]. missing for 10: SDK coverage beyond Python and TypeScript (the same community user notes other languages must use the OpenAPI spec directly), in-depth SDK reference documentation such as typing or versioning in the evidence.
